heading: Commission appointments; compensation, travel expenses, and claims

children.heading: Appointment
children.text: The United States commissioners on the Commission shall be appointed by the President, in accordance with paragraph 2 of article 8 of the Agreement, after taking into consideration the recommendations of—
the Secretary;
the Secretary of State; and
the Alaska Nanuuq Commission.

children.heading: Qualifications
children.text: With respect to the United States commissioners appointed under this subsection, in accordance with paragraph 2 of article 8 of the Agreement—
1 United States commissioner shall be an official of the Federal Government;
1 United States commissioner shall be a representative of the Native people of Alaska, and, in particular, the Native people for whom polar bears are an integral part of their culture; and
both commissioners shall be knowledgeable of, or have expertise in, polar bears.

children.heading: Service and term
children.text: Each United States commissioner shall serve—
at the pleasure of the President; and
for an initial 4-year term and such additional terms as the President shall determine.

children.heading: In general
children.text: Any individual appointed to fill a vacancy occurring before the expiration of any term of office of a United States commissioner shall be appointed for the remainder of that term.

children.heading: Manner
children.text: Any vacancy on the Commission shall be filled in the same manner as the original appointment.

children.heading: In general
children.text: The Secretary, in consultation with the Secretary of State and the Alaska Nanuuq Commission, shall designate an alternate commissioner for each member of the United States section.

children.heading: Duties
children.text: In the absence of a United States commissioner, an alternate commissioner may exercise all functions of the United States commissioner at any meetings of the Commission or of the United States section.

children.heading: Reappointment
children.text: An alternate commissioner—
shall be eligible for reappointment by the President; and
may attend all meetings of the United States section.

tree.heading: Duties
tree.text: The members of the United States section may carry out the functions and responsibilities described in article 8 of the Agreement in accordance with this subchapter and the Agreement.

children.heading: Compensation
children.text: A member of the United States section shall serve without compensation.

children.heading: Travel expenses
children.text: A member of the United States section shall be allowed travel expenses, including per diem in lieu of subsistence, at rates authorized for an employee of an agency under subchapter I of chapter 57 of title 5 while away from the home or regular place of business of the member in the performance of the duties of the United States-Russia Polar Bear Commission.

tree.heading: Agency designation
tree.text: The United States section shall, for the purpose of title 28 relating to claims against the United States and tort claims procedure, be considered to be a Federal agency.
